metadata.label: Integrator
metadata.description: Continuous-time integrator with gain, initial state S0, and saturation bounds [LL, UL]: dx/dt = GAIN * u.
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 2 (Linear Continuous Integrator)

metadata.label: First-Order Lag
metadata.description: First-order low-pass lag filter: H(s) = GAIN / (1 + TAU * s).
metadata.provenance: Franklin, Powell & Emami-Naeini, Feedback Control of Dynamic Systems, 8th ed., Ch. 3

metadata.label: Lead-Lag Compensator
metadata.description: First-order lead-lag compensator: H(s) = GAIN * (1 + TAU1 * s) / (1 + TAU2 * s).
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 6 (Lead-Lag Compensation)

metadata.label: Scalar Gain
metadata.description: Multiplies input signal by scalar gain K with optional bias B: y = K * u + B.
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 2 (Proportional Block)

metadata.label: Summing Junction
metadata.description: Weighted algebraic summation of up to 4 inputs: y = sum(K_i * u_i).
metadata.provenance: Franklin, Powell & Emami-Naeini, Feedback Control of Dynamic Systems, Ch. 3

metadata.label: Multiplier
metadata.description: Computes scaled product of two input signals: y = K * u0 * u1.
metadata.provenance: Standard Signal-Flow Algebra (IEC 61131-3 / Block Diagram Calculus)

metadata.label: Divider
metadata.description: Protected quotient of two signals: y = K * u0 / u1 with denominator floor EPS.
metadata.provenance: Standard Signal-Flow Algebra (Protected Division)

metadata.label: Second-Order Transfer Function
metadata.description: Standard second-order rational transfer function: H(s) = K * wn^2 / (s^2 + 2*zeta*wn*s + wn^2).
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 5 (Second-Order Systems)

metadata.label: PID Controller
metadata.description: Proportional-Integral-Derivative controller with filtered derivative and anti-windup limits.
metadata.provenance: Åström & Hägglund, Advanced PID Control, ISA, 2006, Ch. 3

metadata.label: Signal Switch
metadata.description: Routes u0 when control signal u2 >= THRESHOLD, otherwise routes u1.
metadata.provenance: Standard Hybrid Signal Routing (IEEE / IEC Control Block Algebra)

metadata.label: Hard Limiter
metadata.description: Clamps input signal within [LL, UL]: y = clamp(u0, LL, UL).
metadata.provenance: Slotine & Li, Applied Nonlinear Control, Prentice-Hall, 1991, Ch. 1

metadata.label: Deadband
metadata.description: Suppresses output to zero inside [DBN, DBP] with linear unity slope outside.
metadata.provenance: Slotine & Li, Applied Nonlinear Control, Prentice-Hall, 1991, Ch. 1

metadata.label: 1D Table Lookup
metadata.description: Piecewise-linear 1D interpolation lookup table over breakpoint pairs (X0..X3, Y0..Y3).
metadata.provenance: Press et al., Numerical Recipes, 3rd ed., Ch. 3 (Piecewise Linear Interpolation)

metadata.label: Analytic Function
metadata.description: Evaluates polynomial/power analytic expression: y = C0 + C1*u + C2*u^2 + C3*u^3.
metadata.provenance: Abramowitz & Stegun, Handbook of Mathematical Functions, NBS, 1964

metadata.label: Function Generator (Ramp/Pulse)
metadata.description: Generates time-varying ramp signal starting at T0 with slope SLOPE clamped to MAX_VAL.
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 5 (Standard Test Signals)

metadata.label: Step Source
metadata.description: Heaviside step source transitioning from V0 to V1 at t = T_STEP.
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 5 (Unit Step Excitation)

metadata.label: Sinusoidal Source
metadata.description: Harmonic excitation generator: y(t) = BIAS + AMP * sin(OMEGA * t + PHASE).
metadata.provenance: Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th ed., Ch. 7 (Frequency Response Excitation)

metadata.label: Hydraulic Orifice
metadata.description: Sharp-edged turbulent orifice: Q = Cd * A * sign(dP) * sqrt(2 * |dP| / rho).
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Eq. (3-5) (Turbulent Orifice Flow)

metadata.label: Hydraulic Pipe (Lumped Inertance & Resistance)
metadata.description: Lumped fluid inertance and Darcy-Weisbach friction line: L_f * dQ/dt = (P_in - P_out) - R_f * Q.
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Ch. 5 (Transmission Line Dynamics)

metadata.label: Gas-Charged Hydraulic Accumulator
metadata.description: Polytropic gas-charged hydraulic accumulator: dP/dt = (beta / V0) * (Q_in - Q_out).
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Ch. 2 (Fluid Compressibility & Accumulators)

metadata.label: Positive-Displacement Hydraulic Pump
metadata.description: Fixed-displacement pump with volumetric leakage slip: Q = D * omega - C_leak * dP.
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Ch. 4 (Pump Flow Continuity)

metadata.label: Proportional Control Valve
metadata.description: Variable-area proportional spool valve governed by turbulent orifice flow scaled by opening x in [0, 1].
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Ch. 4 (Spool Valve Flow Equation)

parameters.description: Maximum orifice area at full stroke

metadata.label: Hydraulic Check Valve
metadata.description: Unidirectional spring-loaded check valve opening above cracking pressure P_CRACK.
metadata.provenance: Watton, Fluid Power Systems, Prentice-Hall, 1989, Ch. 3 (Check Valve Dynamics)

metadata.label: Pressure Relief Valve
metadata.description: Direct-acting pressure relief valve discharging excess flow when P_in - P_out > P_SET.
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Ch. 9 (Relief Valve Stability)

metadata.label: Compressible Hydraulic Cavity
metadata.description: Lumped hydraulic control volume integrating pressure via continuity: dP/dt = (BETA / VOL) * (Q_in - Q_out).
metadata.provenance: Merritt, Hydraulic Control Systems, Wiley, 1967, Eq. (2-14) (Continuity in Control Volume)

metadata.label: Compressible Gas Volume
metadata.description: Ideal-gas control volume integrating pressure and temperature from net mass flow: dP/dt = (gamma*R*T/V) * (mDot_in - mDot_out).
metadata.provenance: Shapiro, The Dynamics and Thermodynamics of Compressible Fluid Flow, Vol. 1, Wiley, 1953

metadata.label: Compressible Gas Orifice
metadata.description: Isentropic compressible orifice flow with automatic choked/subsonic regime switching.
metadata.provenance: Shapiro, Compressible Fluid Flow, Vol. 1, Ch. 4 (Isentropic Orifice Mass Flow)

metadata.label: Compressible Gas Control Valve
metadata.description: Modulated pneumatic/gas valve combining compressible choked/subsonic flow with normalized command opening.
metadata.provenance: ISO 6358 / Shapiro, Compressible Fluid Flow, Vol. 1, Ch. 4

metadata.label: Thermal-Pneumatic Chamber
metadata.description: Variable-energy ideal gas chamber with convective wall heat transfer and pressure integration.
metadata.provenance: Anderson, Modern Compressible Flow, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill, 2003, Ch. 2

metadata.label: Converging-Diverging Nozzle
metadata.description: Isentropic converging-diverging nozzle computing choked/subsonic mass flow and exit Mach estimate.
metadata.provenance: Anderson, Modern Compressible Flow, 3rd ed., Ch. 5 (Quasi-One-Dimensional Nozzle Flow)

metadata.label: Gas Heat Exchanger
metadata.description: Lumped effectiveness-NTU first-order thermal heat exchanger: tau * dT_out/dt = T_eq - T_out.
metadata.provenance: Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 7th ed., Ch. 11 (Effectiveness-NTU)

metadata.label: Linear Resistor
metadata.description: Ohm's law resistive branch: I = (V_pos - V_neg) / R, P = I^2 * R.
metadata.provenance: Alexander & Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 6th ed., Ch. 2

metadata.label: Linear Capacitor
metadata.description: Dynamic capacitor voltage integration: C * dV/dt = I_in - V / R_leak.
metadata.provenance: Alexander & Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 6th ed., Ch. 6

metadata.label: Linear Inductor
metadata.description: Dynamic inductor current integration with winding resistance: L * dI/dt = V_in - R * I.
metadata.provenance: Alexander & Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 6th ed., Ch. 6

metadata.label: Controlled Voltage Source
metadata.description: DC/AC controlled voltage source with internal series impedance R_s.
metadata.provenance: Alexander & Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, 6th ed., Ch. 4

metadata.label: Permanent-Magnet DC Motor
metadata.description: Coupled armature-rotor DC machine: L*di/dt = V - R*i - Ke*w; J*dw/dt = Kt*i - B*w - T_load.
metadata.provenance: Krause, Wasynczuk & Sudhoff, Analysis of Electric Machinery and Drive Systems, 3rd ed., Ch. 2

metadata.label: Three-Phase Induction Motor
metadata.description: Equivalent-circuit slip-torque induction machine with mechanical rotor inertia dynamics.
metadata.provenance: Krause, Wasynczuk & Sudhoff, Analysis of Electric Machinery and Drive Systems, 3rd ed., Ch. 6

metadata.label: Power Electronic Inverter
metadata.description: Averaged PWM inverter bridge with first-order switching filter and efficiency loss.
metadata.provenance: Mohan, Undeland & Robbins, Power Electronics, 3rd ed., Wiley, 2003, Ch. 8

metadata.label: US Standard Atmosphere (ISA 1976)
metadata.description: Computes ISA 1976 / ISO 2533 air density (rho), static pressure (P), temperature (T), and speed of sound (a) from geometric altitude h (m).
metadata.provenance: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA/NASA/USAF) & ISO 2533:1975

metadata.label: Rigid Body Translational/Rotational Dynamics
metadata.description: Newton-Euler rigid body point-mass & pitch-axis dynamics: m*dv/dt = F - c*v, I*dq/dt = M.
metadata.provenance: Stevens & Lewis, Aircraft Control and Simulation, 3rd ed., Wiley, 2015, Ch. 1

metadata.label: Aerodynamic Forces & Moments
metadata.description: Computes dynamic pressure q = 0.5*rho*V^2, lift L = q*S*(CL0 + CLa*alpha), and parabolic drag D = q*S*(CD0 + K*CL^2).
metadata.provenance: Stevens & Lewis, Aircraft Control and Simulation, 3rd ed., Ch. 2 (Aerodynamic Coefficients)

metadata.label: Turbine / Propulsion Engine
metadata.description: First-order spool thrust lag with altitude density lapse: tau * dT/dt = T_max*(rho/rho0)*throttle - T.
metadata.provenance: Mattingly, Elements of Propulsion: Gas Turbines and Rockets, AIAA, 2006, Ch. 4

metadata.label: Flight Control Surface Actuator
metadata.description: Rate- and position-limited first-order electro-hydraulic flight control servo actuator.
metadata.provenance: Stevens & Lewis, Aircraft Control and Simulation, 3rd ed., Ch. 4 (Actuator Models)

metadata.label: Two-Phase Evaporator
metadata.description: Lumped vapor-compression evaporator enthalpy & temperature dynamics with convective heat load.
metadata.provenance: ASHRAE Handbook — Refrigeration, Ch. 2 (Vapor-Compression Cycle Evaporator)

metadata.label: Two-Phase Condenser
metadata.description: Lumped vapor-compression condenser rejecting heat to ambient sink via first-order thermal dynamics.
metadata.provenance: ASHRAE Handbook — Refrigeration, Ch. 2 (Vapor-Compression Cycle Condenser)

metadata.label: Thermostatic Expansion Valve (TXV)
metadata.description: Superheat-modulated expansion valve metering two-phase refrigerant mass flow across pressure drop.
metadata.provenance: ASHRAE Handbook — Refrigeration, Ch. 11 (Thermostatic Expansion Valve Flow)

metadata.label: Vapor-Cycle Compressor
metadata.description: Polytropic vapor-cycle compressor computing refrigerant mass flow, discharge temperature, and shaft power.
metadata.provenance: ASHRAE Handbook — Fundamentals, Ch. 2 (Isentropic/Polytropic Compression)
